title: The Angel of the Lord at Bokim and a New Generation
description: The Angel of the Lord went up from Gilgal to Bokim and accused Israel of breaking the covenant by failing to tear down the altars of foreign gods. The people wept and offered sacrifices to the Lord. After Joshua's death, a new generation arose that did not know the Lord, and they worshiped Baal and Ashtoreth. The Lord handed them over to their enemies, but raised up judges who delivered them as long as the judge lived—and so began the cycle that characterizes the period of the judges.
